description: This is a Java class implementing the OrderService interface in an e-commerce system, managing order processing, status management, total calculations, invoice generation, and related operations within the SalesManager framework.

classes.name: OrderServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the OrderService interface, providing order processing, total calculation, invoice generation, and order management functionalities within an e-commerce context.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a status history record to an order and updates the order.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order including payment, status initialization, and persistence.

methods.name: caculateOrder
methods.description: Calculates order totals, including subtotals, shipping, taxes, and grand total based on the order summary.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates total order summaries from an order summary, customer, store, and language context.

methods.name: caculateShoppingCart
methods.description: Calculates the total for a shopping cart including prices, taxes, and shipping details.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Public method to calculate the total of a shopping cart with customer and store context.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Overloaded method to calculate shopping cart total based only on cart, store, and language.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Generates a PDF invoice for an order.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all orders for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists orders for a store based on given criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new order or updates an existing one.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks if an order contains downloadable files.
